name: Views Data Export Excel
description: Extends the Views Data Export module to add Excel support.
project_description: Extends the Views Data Export module to add a native Excel (.xlsx) export format. It ships one Views display plugin and one Views style plugin (both id data_export_excel) that subclass the DataExport display and style from Views Data Export and mix in the Excel traits from the XLS Serialization module, which does the actual spreadsheet writing via phpoffice/phpspreadsheet. Because it subclasses classes owned by Views Data Export, a BC break in those classes can break this module. Requires XLS Serialization 2.1.0+ and is compatible with the XLS Serialization Extras feature set. The maintainers note that ideally Views Data Export would offer a pluggable format architecture so third-party formats could be added without subclassing.
